decisions.reason: The request removes pineapple text from the bottle in the standalone strawberry asset; it does not change the distinct bottle-and-cloud slogan design or its specified slogan text.
The steak-and-onion grill illustration has no bottle or pineapple-text requirement, so its state remains unchanged.
The stamped-meat illustration is a separate design and contains no bottle or pineapple-text attribute affected by the source decision.
The Riverton sky text belongs to a separate illustration and is unrelated to removing pineapple text from the standalone strawberry asset's bottle.
Removing text from one illustrated bottle does not alter the cross-design requirement that the artwork be hand-drawn and non-AI.
